scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Notice: this is a pnpm workspace (uses pnpm catalog + workspace: protocol). Installing with npm/yarn will only install the root package and will not wire up the internal @workspace/* packages. Run: corepack enable && pnpm install" >&2 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: corepack enable 1>&2 && pnpm install 1>&2 && pnpm --filter @workspace/scoutrank run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:scoutrank: corepack enable 1>&2 && pnpm install 1>&2 && pnpm --filter @workspace/scoutrank run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
